text: 1. Create a Payment using the **New Payment** dialog; this will automatically populate various fields based on the data in the bank account transaction and once created the new Payment will be matched and reconciled with the bank account transaction; if the status of the new payment is set to Delivered (the default) it will automatically post to the GL and the GL Transaction will also be matched and reconciled with the bank account transaction
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
